detail: Web portal connecting employers with job seekers is an online public service used directly by citizens and businesses; under R12 (rules 0.3) it is TECH-DGOV wherever it sits. Should be scope_basis chapter+theme, themes TECH-DGOV; the 0.2 note removing the tag is outdated
One sentence carrying two same-type recommendations (EESSI; EHIC data). Rules require a split only for claims of different types, so left as is (same pattern in -0060 and -0116)

Typed intervention, but the quote names no law, system or institution ('Electronic registration through e-signature is already possible'); R11 does not say whether an unnamed online service counts as a named system or a described situation (finding)

Typed intervention, but the quote names no measure (the Central Registry is named only in the preceding sentence); R11 is unclear whether an unnamed online access service is an intervention or a finding

Quote covers two sentences with two separate requirements (EU registers treating NMK companies as EU companies; membership of EU/EEA-only expert groups). Cut to the first sentence; second sentence becomes new item -0185

'It will, however, need to align with ... to be able to interconnect with BRIS' is an EU expectation looking forward: recommendation (as -0107 and -0108 'will need to' are typed in this file). Drop ambiguous_type

'Medium and large companies must submit their annual accounts electronically' describes a legal obligation without naming a law, system or programme; under R11 it is a finding (stated_status and intervention_as_stated cleared)
